name: Hawaii
sources: 2025-2026 rate schedules and 2026 standard deduction (Act 46, SLH 2024): Hawaii DoTax Announcement 2024-03, https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/announce/ann24-03.pdf

Act 24, SLH 2026 changes brackets from 2027 only; standard deduction increases kept: DoTax TRC legislative update, https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/stats/trc/docs2025/2026-05-Karacaovali_Presentation_TRC_Legislative_Update.pdf and EY Tax News 2026-1440, https://taxnews.ey.com/news/2026-1440-hawaii-legislation-establishes-higher-personal-income-tax-on-income-over-1-million
Personal exemption $1,144 per exemption incl. extra exemption for 65+; capital gains worksheet: 2025 Form N-11, https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/forms/2025/n11_i.pdf
provisional: Itemizing rules (no SALT cap, 7.5% medical floor, itemizing allowed without itemizing federally) are carried over from prior-year Hawaii law; the 2025/2026 itemized-deduction instructions could not be confirmed.
notes: Hawaii trims itemized deductions for higher incomes; that limit is not applied here.
Qualified dividends are taxed as ordinary income; only long-term gains get the 7.25% maximum rate.
